contexts.text: The things in the text of the Word.
In the Original... the text was continuous, in imitation of the heavenly speech.
The internal text is so connected that not a syllable could be omitted...
All the interior tissues would be scattered.
When the Word is read by man in the Hebrew text. DeVerbo 4.
For this reason there has been no mutilation... not even in a word or letter in the original text.
All the letters in the Hebrew text were counted by the Masorites.
4. As their textures are intricate and various.
